demand_peak.detail: Black Friday (late Nov) through Christmas (Dec) is the absolute peak for winter gear. A secondary spike occurs during cold snaps in Jan-Feb. Gift-giving drives Dec; self-use drives Nov.

clearance.detail: Post-holiday markdowns begin late Dec/early Jan; deep clearance runs Jan-Feb; final sell-through / end-of-season by March. Retailers reset floor to spring by Feb-Mar.

US.notes: Black Friday/Cyber Monday (late Nov) is the single largest event. Cold-snap re-buys in Jan. Largest absolute winter market.

UK.notes: Milder maritime winter; demand is late-shifted vs US/CA. Boxing Day (26 Dec) is a major clearance trigger.

CA.notes: Coldest/longest winter of the group; pre-season buying is earliest. Strong Jan-Feb cold-snap re-buys.

DE.notes: Largest EU winter market. Advent/St. Nicholas (early Dec) and Christmas drive gift demand. Ski season demand peaks Dec-Mar.

FR.notes: Ski/alpine demand (Alps) is significant; winter-sport buying peaks Nov-Jan.

NL.notes: Mild maritime climate; winter gear demand driven by commuting/cycling cold protection + ski holidays. Sinterklaas (5 Dec) adds a gift peak.

consumer_buy_start.AU: March-April (pre-season; early buyers start late March)

demand_peak.detail: Pre-winter + start-of-winter purchasing peaks May-Jun; deep-winter (Jul) sustained demand; Aug is the tail.

clearance.detail: End-of-winter clearance runs Aug-Sep; retailers reset to spring by September-October.

AU.notes: Snow season (ski fields) runs roughly June-September in alpine regions. Winter demand is milder and shorter than NH.

NZ.notes: Ski season June-October (some fields). South Island alpine drives winter-sport demand.

northern_hemisphere.assessment: Ordering 2026-10-31 with 2-3wk shipping lands inventory ~mid-Nov 2026. That is just before the Nov-Dec peak (Black Friday 27 Nov, Christmas), so it can capture the second half of the buying window (late Nov - Dec) and the Jan-Feb cold-snap tail. HOWEVER it misses the Sep-Oct early-bird/pre-season demand and risks selling into a compressed window with less margin for error.
northern_hemisphere.recommendation: If ordering today, ship a small, fast-turning core (insulated mid-layer, base layers, gloves/beanie, waterproof shells) as an immediate fill-in; do NOT treat this as the main 2026/27 winter allocation. Plan the bulk 2026/27 inventory as a 2027/28 pre-season order to be placed Jan-Apr 2027 for arrival Aug-Sep 2027 (NH) - i.e. shift planning to 2027/28.

southern_hemisphere.assessment: AU/NZ winter is June-Aug. Ordering 2026-10-31 with 2-3wk shipping arrives mid-Nov 2026, which is AU/NZ summer - completely outside the SH winter season. The 2026 SH winter (Jun-Aug 2026) has already passed.
southern_hemisphere.recommendation: Do not ship 2026/27 winter stock to AU/NZ now. Target the 2027 SH winter: place order for arrival Apr-May 2027 (before the May-Jun peak). This is the 2027/28 planning cycle from the NH calendar perspective.

cross_season_year_round_products: Base layers / thermal underwear (used year-round; winter peak)

Camping/tent & shelter basics (spring-autumn peak, still sellable winter)

Hiking/summit packs (year-round; winter only adds a snow-specific top line)

summary.north_winter_peak: Nov-Dec (Black Friday through Christmas); secondary Jan-Feb cold-snap
summary.key_recommendation: For 2026/27, treat northern-hemisphere winter as a MARGINAL late fill-in only (small, fast-turning core shipped immediately). Do not make 2026/27 the primary allocation. Replan the full winter program for 2027/28 with pre-season orders placed 2027 Jan-Apr for arrival by Aug 2027 (NH) / Apr-May 2027 (SH). AU/NZ: skip 2026/27 entirely, shift to 2027 SH winter.
